description: Entity threat overrides for RotN 3.3.4, beyond the dump's `hostile` (= the class implements IMob). Read by catalog.entity(): `hostile` becomes true for every entry with targetsPlayers, and `dangerous` marks threats to avoid rather than fight. Every entry cites the mod's own bytecode.
method: javap -c -p (reads class files; no mod code is run) on the mod jars of the pinned server pack zip (SHA-256 90642fd5...f5205), extracted to a scratch folder outside the repo, 2026-11-02. Scope: every modded living entity whose class does not implement IMob (317 in the second dump). For each, the entity class and its mod superclasses were scanned for a targeting AI task (class name containing 'Target') whose constructor receives EntityPlayer.class; tasks that target EntityLivingBase with a predicate were reviewed by reading the predicate's apply(). EntityAIHurtByTarget (retaliation) is not counted.

confidence.verified: The bytecode shows players are targeted (an EntityPlayer target class without a predicate, or a predicate read and found to accept players).
confidence.task: A targeting task with EntityPlayer or EntityLivingBase as its target class; its predicate or shouldExecute was not inspected.
confidence.conditional: The player-targeting task is only added in some state.

alreadyHostileViaIMob: iceandfire:cyclops, iceandfire:if_hydra, iceandfire:gorgon, iceandfire:if_troll, iceandfire:stymphalianbird and iceandfire:siren implement IMob, so the dump already marks them hostile; they need no override.

iceandfire:deathworm.evidence: IceAndFireRotN-1.9.1-1.2.1.jar: EntityDeathWorm constructor adds DeathWormAITarget(EntityLivingBase.class, EntityDeathWorm$1). EntityDeathWorm$1.apply: when not tamed (func_70909_n), the target must be an EntityAnimal or EntityPlayer (or anything, with config deathWormAttackMonsters), alive, and not the owner (func_152114_e).
iceandfire:deathworm.note: Desert sand worm; large variants are lethal early. Avoid deserts at first.

iceandfire:firedragon.evidence: IceAndFireRotN-1.9.1-1.2.1.jar: EntityFireDragon extends EntityDragonBase. EntityDragonBase.initEntityAI (func_184651_r) adds DragonAITargetNonTamed(EntityPlayer.class, EntityDragonBase$1), and EntityDragonBase$1.apply(player) = DragonUtils.canHostilesTarget(player) && !player.isCreative() (func_184812_l_). A second task, DragonAITarget(EntityLivingBase.class, EntityDragonBase$2), targets other living entities.
iceandfire:firedragon.note: Ice and Fire dragon: very large, flies and breathes fire/ice. Untamed dragons hunt players. Avoid; do not fight in the early game.
